article.title: 陳國基鼓勵機電工程營運基金為香港高質量發展注入持久動能
article.text: ​政務司司長陳國基主持機電工程營運基金30周年紀念典禮。他致辭說，營運基金成立30年，已由主要負責維修機電設備，發展成為各政府部門的「機電設施守護者」和「創新促成者」，並一直以先行者角色積極推動公共服務數字化和智能化轉型。 陳國基又鼓勵營運基金繼續勇於創新，精益求精，協助各政府部門加快應用創新科技，讓市民享受更優質、更便捷的服務，同時為香港高質量發展注入持久動能。 機電署署長兼營運基金總經理潘國英致辭說，營運基金會以機電智能化提升服務質素與效能，以創科引領行業革新，與客戶部門同心協力，落實各個創新構想，成就更優質的公共服務。

rewrite.summary: 政務司司長陳國基話機電工程營運基金成立咗三十年，鼓勵佢哋繼續創新，為香港發展出力。

aids.context_en: A Hong Kong government news story about Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan officiating at the 30th anniversary ceremony of the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund (EMSTF), which operates under the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD).

levels.text_en: Chief Secretary Eric Chan hosted the 30th anniversary ceremony of the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund. He said the fund has been established for 30 years, changing from mainly making electrical and mechanical equipment before to now helping various government departments look after electrical and mechanical facilities and leading in innovation. He also encouraged the fund to keep doing new things and be the best, so citizens can enjoy better, more convenient services, and at the same time contribute to Hong Kong's development.

Chief Secretary Eric Chan hosted the 30th anniversary ceremony of the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund. In his speech he said the fund has been established for 30 years; before it was mainly responsible for maintaining electrical and mechanical equipment, and now it has become the "guardian of electrical and mechanical facilities" and "enabler of innovation" for various government departments, all along leading the push of public services toward digitalization and intelligence. Chan also encouraged the fund to keep being bold in innovation and be the best, helping various government departments speed up the use of innovative technology, so citizens can enjoy higher-quality, more convenient services, and at the same time injecting lasting momentum into Hong Kong's high-quality development. The Director of Electrical and Mechanical Services, Pun Kwok-ying, also spoke, saying they will continue to use innovation and technology to drive industry reform and work with client departments to do public services well.

article.title: 天文台料今日初時本港雨勢有時頗大　部分地區有機會水浸

article.title: 康文署稱全民運動日有近33萬人次參與免費康體活動及使用設施
article.text: 康文署表示，昨日的「全民運動日」有近33萬人次參與由康文署舉辦的免費康體活動，和免費使用康樂設施。 康文署說，今年首次於8月1日及2日，一連兩日免費開放康樂設施，當中體育館主場的使用率超過95%，公眾游泳池的總入場人次超過10萬。 署方又指，「全民運動日2026」吸引逾2萬6000人次參加在全港十八區指定體育館舉行的多項免費康體活動，涵蓋亞運會項目的同樂體驗活動，例如武術、手球、足球、賽艇、馬術和滑板等，其他活動包括體育示範、健體閣，以及適合不同年齡人士和殘疾人士參與的活動，亦受到市民歡迎。

aids.context_en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) of Hong Kong reports on turnout for its annual 'Sport For All Day,' a promotional event with free sports activities and free use of leisure facilities across the city's 18 districts.

levels.text_en: The LCSD said that yesterday's 'Sport For All Day' drew nearly 330,000 visits by people going to enjoy free sports activities run by the LCSD, or to use leisure facilities for free. This year, for the first time, on August 1 and 2, facilities were opened free of charge for two consecutive days. Many people went to use them, especially the sports centres and swimming pools, which were packed.

The LCSD said that yesterday's 'Sport For All Day' drew nearly 330,000 visits by people going to take part in free sports activities run by the LCSD and to use leisure facilities for free. This year, for the first time, on August 1 and 2, facilities were opened free of charge for two consecutive days. Among these, the usage rate of sports centre main halls exceeded 95%, and total attendance at public swimming pools exceeded 100,000. The department also said 'Sport For All Day 2026' drew over 26,000 visits, with people taking part in various free sports activities at designated sports centres across all 18 districts of Hong Kong. It was very popular with the public.

This year, for the first time, on August 1 and 2, leisure facilities were opened free of charge for two consecutive days. Among these, the usage rate of sports centre main halls exceeded 95%, and total attendance at public swimming pools exceeded 100,000. The department also noted that 'Sport For All Day 2026' attracted over 26,000 visits, with people taking part in various free recreation and sports activities at designated sports centres across all 18 districts of Hong Kong, including fun experience sessions of Asian Games events such as wushu, handball, football, rowing, equestrian and skateboarding. Other activities also included sports demonstrations, fitness corners, and activities suitable for people of different ages and people with disabilities, all of which were very popular with the public.

article.title: 男子大埔參加三項鐵人賽期間失聯　獲救送院後不治
article.text: 一名男子在大埔參與三項鐵人賽期間失聯，消防在大美督對開海面將他救起，送院搶救後不治。主辦單位對事件深表哀悼，向家屬致以最深切慰問。 有體育學者認為，大美督是三項鐵人的常用賽道，海浪不大。而三項鐵人賽事的參賽者，一般在訓練上都有所準備。

rewrite.summary: 一個男人喺大埔玩三項鐵人賽嗰陣唔見咗，消防救返上嚟，送咗去醫院都救唔返。

aids.context_en: A man went missing during a triathlon in Tai Po (a district in Hong Kong). He was rescued from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk but later died. Organizers expressed sorrow and a sports scholar commented on the venue and typical preparation of participants.

levels.text_en: A man went missing while doing a triathlon in Tai Po. Firefighters rescued him from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk and took him to the hospital, but he could not be saved. The organizers said they were very sad and apologized to his family. A person in sports said Tai Mei Tuk is often used for competitions, the waves aren't big, and people who take part usually prepare with training.

A man went missing while taking part in a triathlon in Tai Po. Firefighters rescued him from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk and sent him to the hospital for emergency treatment, but he could not be saved. The organizers said they were very saddened and offered their deepest condolences to his family. A sports scholar believes Tai Mei Tuk is a course often used for triathlons, and the waves aren't that big. He also said that people who take part in triathlons generally have a certain level of preparation in training.

A man lost contact while participating in a triathlon in Tai Po. Firefighters rescued him from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk, sent him to the hospital for emergency treatment, but he died. The organizers expressed deep grief over the incident and offered their deepest condolences to the deceased's family. A sports scholar believes Tai Mei Tuk is a commonly used triathlon course, and the waves aren't that big. He also pointed out that participants in triathlons generally have a certain level of preparation in training, and would not enter the competition without any training at all.

A man lost contact while participating in a triathlon in Tai Po. Firefighters rescued him from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk. He was sent to the hospital for emergency treatment but died. The organizers felt very saddened by the incident and expressed condolences to the deceased's family. A sports scholar said Tai Mei Tuk is a commonly used triathlon course and the waves are not big. He also noted that people who take part in this kind of event generally prepare in training.

A man lost contact while participating in a triathlon in Tai Po. Firefighters rescued him from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk, and he died after being sent to the hospital for emergency treatment. The organizers expressed deep mourning over the incident and offered their deepest condolences to the family. A sports scholar believes Tai Mei Tuk is a commonly used triathlon course and the waves are not big. And triathlon participants generally have some preparation in training.

article.title: 李家超：今次五年規劃與施政報告同時諮詢別具意義
article.text: 行政長官李家超出席首場香港首個五年規劃及施政報告地區諮詢會，他在開場發言時表示，今次的五年規劃與施政報告一併諮詢特別具意義。他形容五年規劃是香港的發展藍圖，五年規劃則是方向性、宏觀性、策略性的指導文件，與施政報告是一脈相承。 李家超說，施政報告除了會做每年的政策，更是五年規劃的年度報告，相關概念是五年規劃將香港發展的五年方向宏觀性、策略性地畫龍點睛，行政長官每年的施政報告就要向社會匯報如何落實五年規劃。 李家超說，政府現時已收集相當大量的意見，都是與五年規劃與施政報告有關，希望市民暢所欲言，又說提出意見時，毋須刻意區分五年規劃或施政報告的意見。 今次諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行，超過130名人士出席。

rewrite.summary: 特首李家超話今次五年規劃同施政報告一齊問市民意見好有意義。

levels.text: 特首李家超去咗第一場地區諮詢會，佢話今次五年規劃同施政報告一齊問大家意見，好有意義。佢話五年規劃係香港未來嘅發展方向，而施政報告每年都會講政府點樣做到呢個計劃。佢想市民有咩都講出嚟，唔使分開兩樣意見。今次個會有超過一百三十人去。

行政長官李家超出席咗香港首場五年規劃同施政報告嘅地區諮詢會。佢開場時話，今次兩樣嘢一齊做諮詢特別有意義。佢話五年規劃係香港嘅發展藍圖，係一份講方向同策略嘅文件，同施政報告係一脈相承。佢又話，施政報告除咗講每年嘅政策，仲係五年規劃嘅年度報告，特首每年都要向社會交代點樣落實個規劃。佢話政府已經收集咗好多意見，希望市民暢所欲言，提意見時唔使刻意分開係規劃定係施政報告。今次個會喺南屯門官立中學舉行，有超過一百三十人出席。

行政長官李家超出席了香港首場五年規劃及施政報告的地區諮詢會。他在開場時說，今次把五年規劃與施政報告一起諮詢，特別有意義。他形容五年規劃是香港的發展藍圖，是一份講方向和策略的文件，與施政報告互相配合。他說施政報告除了講每年的政策，也是五年規劃的年度報告。特首每年都要向社會交代如何落實規劃。他又說政府已收集不少意見，希望市民多發表意見，提意見時不用刻意分開兩者。今次諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行，超過130人出席。

aids.context_en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee attended the first district consultation session for the city's new five-year plan and the annual Policy Address, held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School.

levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee went to the first district consultation session. He said that this time asking everyone's views on the five-year plan and the Policy Address together is very meaningful. He said the five-year plan is Hong Kong's future development direction, while the Policy Address each year talks about how the government achieves this plan. He wants citizens to say whatever they have to say, without needing to separate the two kinds of opinions. More than 130 people attended this session.

Chief Executive John Lee attended Hong Kong's first district consultation session on the five-year plan and the Policy Address. In his opening remarks he said that consulting on these two things together this time is especially meaningful. He said the five-year plan is Hong Kong's development blueprint, a document about direction and strategy, and is in line with the Policy Address. He also said that besides discussing each year's policies, the Policy Address is also the annual report of the five-year plan, and the Chief Executive must account to society each year on how the plan is being implemented. He said the government has already collected many opinions, and hopes citizens will speak freely, and that when giving opinions they need not deliberately separate whether it concerns the plan or the Policy Address. This session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with more than 130 people attending.

Chief Executive John Lee attended Hong Kong's first district consultation session on the five-year plan and the Policy Address. In his opening remarks he said that consulting on the five-year plan and the Policy Address together this time is especially meaningful. He described the five-year plan as Hong Kong's development blueprint, a directional, macro and strategic guiding document, in line with the Policy Address. Lee said that besides handling each year's policies, the Policy Address is also the annual report of the five-year plan, and the Chief Executive must report to society each year on how the five-year plan is being implemented. He also said the government has already collected quite a lot of opinions, all related to both, and hopes citizens will speak freely, and that when giving opinions they need not deliberately distinguish whether it concerns the plan or the Policy Address. This consultation session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with more than 130 people attending.

Chief Executive John Lee attended Hong Kong's first district consultation session on the five-year plan and the Policy Address. In his opening he said that consulting on the five-year plan and the Policy Address together this time is especially meaningful. He described the five-year plan as Hong Kong's development blueprint, a document about direction and strategy, working in coordination with the Policy Address. He said that besides discussing each year's policies, the Policy Address is also the annual report of the five-year plan. The Chief Executive must account to society each year on how the plan is being implemented. He also said the government has already collected quite a few opinions, and hopes citizens will express more opinions, and that when giving opinions they need not deliberately separate the two. This consultation session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with more than 130 people attending.

Chief Executive John Lee attended the first district consultation session for Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address. In his opening remarks he said that consulting on the five-year plan and the Policy Address together this time is especially meaningful. He described the five-year plan as Hong Kong's development blueprint; the five-year plan is a directional, macro and strategic guiding document, in line with the Policy Address. Lee said that besides doing each year's policies, the Policy Address is even more so the annual report of the five-year plan. The related concept is that the five-year plan macro-strategically adds the finishing touch to Hong Kong's five-year development direction, and the Chief Executive's Policy Address each year must report to society on how the five-year plan is being implemented. Lee said the government has now collected quite a large amount of opinions, all related to the five-year plan and the Policy Address, and he hopes citizens will speak freely, and also said that when raising opinions there is no need to deliberately distinguish opinions on the five-year plan or the Policy Address. This consultation session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with more than 130 people attending.

article.title: 李家超今早出席地區諮詢會　聽取地區人士意見和建議
article.text: 行政長官李家超今日率領多名司局長，出席首場《香港第一個五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會》，聽取地區人士的意見和建議。 首場諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行，早上9時許，陸續有問責官員到場，包括政務司司長陳國基及副司長卓永興、財政司司長陳茂波及副司長黃偉綸、勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡、創新科技及工業局局長孫東等。 李家超昨日在社交媒體表示，今場地區諮詢會會以小組討論形式，與市民就「拼經濟謀發展」及「惠民生建未來」進行交流；市民可收看電視或網上直播。

rewrite.summary: 李家超今朝去咗屯門開會，聽街坊講意見。

levels.text: 李家超今朝帶咗好多官員，去屯門開第一場地區諮詢會，聽下街坊嘅意見同建議。個會喺一間中學度開，早上九點幾就陸續有官員到場。李家超話今次會分做細組傾偈，同市民一齊講點樣搞好經濟同民生。市民可以睇電視或者上網睇直播。

aids.context_en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee held the first district consultation session (for Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address) at a school in Tuen Mun, bringing along senior officials to hear residents' views.

levels.text_en: This morning John Lee brought many officials to Tuen Mun to hold the first district consultation session, to hear residents' opinions and suggestions. The meeting was held at a secondary school, with officials arriving one after another after 9 in the morning. Lee said this session would be split into small groups for discussion, talking with citizens about how to improve the economy and people's livelihoods. Citizens can watch on TV or online via live broadcast.

Chief Executive John Lee today brought along several bureau secretaries to attend the first district consultation session, to hear residents' opinions and suggestions. This session was held at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with officials arriving one after another after 9 in the morning, including Chief Secretary Eric Chan, Financial Secretary Paul Chan, and Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun, and others. Lee said yesterday on social media that this session would use a small-group discussion format, talking with citizens about how to improve the economy and people's livelihoods. Citizens can watch on TV or online via live broadcast.

Chief Executive John Lee today led numerous bureau secretaries to attend the first 'District Consultation Session for Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address', to hear the views and suggestions of district residents. The first consultation session was held at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with accountable officials arriving one after another after 9 in the morning, including Chief Secretary Eric Chan and Deputy Chief Secretary Warner Cheuk, Financial Secretary Paul Chan and Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun, and Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong. Lee said yesterday on social media that this district consultation session would use a small-group discussion format, exchanging views with citizens on 'striving for the economy and seeking development' and 'benefiting livelihoods and building the future'; citizens can watch on TV or online live broadcast.

Citizens can watch on TV or online live broadcast.
